title: Braindrain Gloves

sources.title: Mental Interference
markers: | description = When you deal {{DamageType|Psychic}} damage, you also inflict {{Cond|Mental Fatigue}} for 2 turns.

summary: Deal Psychic damage to give the target Mental Fatigue for 2 turns. Mental Fatigue penalizes Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves by 1 per turn remaining. Failing such a save at 5+ turns deals 1d4 Psychic and removes the condition.

fields.Effect: Deal Psychic damage to give the target Mental Fatigue for 2 turns. Mental Fatigue penalizes Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves by 1 per turn remaining. Failing such a save at 5+ turns deals 1d4 Psychic and removes the condition.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
